checklist_items.label: Repository/source verification
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Confirm you are reading VOID public-node materials from the intended source before preparing any machine.

checklist_items.label: Machine stability
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Use a machine that can remain stable for long-running node processes and clean restarts.

checklist_items.label: Operating system hygiene
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Keep the operating system maintained, patched, and free of unnecessary risky workloads.

checklist_items.label: Runtime dependency readiness
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Prepare to install and verify only documented runtime dependencies once public node operation instructions are released.

checklist_items.label: Firewall/router review
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Understand local firewall and router behavior before exposing any public node service.

checklist_items.label: Public reachability plan
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Plan how the node would be reachable later, without treating this checklist as permission to advertise or register a live node.

checklist_items.label: DataNet storage plan
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Plan storage capacity, growth, filesystem hygiene, and separation of public data from private/operator-only material.

checklist_items.label: Backup and restore plan
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Prepare a simple backup and restore routine before relying on the machine for node operation.

checklist_items.label: Uptime and power plan
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Consider power stability, network stability, and restart procedures.

checklist_items.label: Logs and monitoring plan
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Prepare to retain useful logs locally without leaking secrets or private operator data.

checklist_items.label: Secrets boundary
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Keep secrets, secret key material, secret recovery material, credentials, and operator-only files out of public directories.

checklist_items.label: Validator separation
checklist_items.operator_self_check: Understand that public node readiness does not equal validator candidacy, validator admission, or active validator status.

checklist_items.label: Wallet and funding boundary
checklist_items.operator_self_check: This checklist does not connect wallets, request stake, request funds, approve payments, or authorize transfers.

checklist_items.label: Operator acknowledgement
checklist_items.operator_self_check: A prospective operator should understand that this is preparation guidance only and does not submit anything to VOID.

operator_notice: This public checklist is preparation guidance only. It does not register a node, activate a validator, connect a wallet, accept stake, submit data, or mutate network state.
